name: Overcoming
overview: Scripture reveals that overcoming is rooted in the victory Christ has already secured over the world, offering believers peace amid tribulation and the strength to face all challenges. Through His love, we are empowered to be more than conquerors, not allowing evil to defeat us but instead overcoming evil with good. This victory calls for a surrendered life, presenting ourselves as living sacrifices and laying aside sin, so we can run the race with patience and confidence in Christ's sustaining power.
